title: Policies
intro: By placing an order, you acknowledge that you have read and agreed to the policies below.
body:
Pickup is in Erlton, Calgary SW near Stampede Park. Delivery is not available.

Pickup windows are Wed–Fri between 11am–1pm and 4–6pm, and Sat–Sun between 10am–1pm. Please plan pickup in advance; availability outside scheduled pickup times cannot be guaranteed.

If your party is at a venue, please confirm that the venue accepts cakes from a home bakery. Honey Bee Cakes does not operate from an AHS-inspected commercial kitchen.

Pricing is firm and final; discounts are not offered.

A 50% deposit is required within 24 hours to reserve your date. The remaining balance is due at pickup.

Changes, rescheduling or cancellations must be requested at least 4 days before pickup. If you cancel more than 4 days before pickup, your deposit will be refunded. If you cancel within 4 days of pickup, the deposit is normally non-refundable, although a refund may be considered in rare and exceptional circumstances. A change of plans does not automatically qualify.

If a cake is not picked up on the scheduled date, it is kept for a maximum of 2 days and then discarded.

All products are prepared in a home kitchen that handles common allergens including eggs, dairy, gluten, nuts, honey, berries, cinnamon and others. Cross-contact may occur. Products are not intended for individuals with severe allergies.

It is the customer’s responsibility to review flavour descriptions, cake sizes and serving suggestions before ordering. Refunds are not issued for misunderstandings regarding size or flavour after pickup.

Cakes should be refrigerated and removed approximately 1–3 hours before serving. Keep cakes flat, refrigerated and away from heat or direct sunlight. Refunds are not issued for damage after pickup, including dropping, tilting, melting or improper storage.

If I am unable to fulfil your order because of illness, emergency or circumstances beyond my control, all payments will be fully refunded. When possible, I will provide advance notice and may offer a rescheduled date.

For questions, concerns or order changes, contact hello@honeybeecakesyyc.ca or @honeybeecakesyyc on Instagram.
